description: An OSV advisory that lists a component but names no CVE yet, so it is no vulnerability Subject and no finding: read it and decide. When OSV lists a CVE for it, the next OSV run records the ordinary affected_by finding and this item is no longer posted.

osv_id.description: The OSV advisory id (GHSA-..., PYSEC-..., ...): read it at https://osv.dev/vulnerability/<osv_id>.

name: security.osv-unkeyed
